title: Intensity, decibels and Doppler
target: Distinguish intensity change from frequency shift.
criteria: Use an intensity ratio separately from pitch.
Predict approach and recession Doppler trends.

authoring.limitations: Reasoning evidence only. Multiple choice does not certify physical performance. Teacher reviews before assigning and rates mastery separately.

cpa.prompt: Two steady tones have the same frequency but different intensities. Which distinction is correct?
options: The stronger tone must have twice the pitch.
They can have similar pitch but different loudness.
cpa.guide: Intensity relates to energy flow per area; pitch is mainly associated with frequency.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

cpa.prompt: At one location, sound intensity rises from 2 × 10⁻⁶ to 8 × 10⁻⁶ W/m² while frequency is fixed. Which statement is supported?
options: Intensity quadruples; frequency and hence nominal pitch stay fixed.
cpa.guide: Compare intensity ratio 8/2 = 4 without confusing it with frequency.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Compare evidence and identify a physical relationship.

cpa.prompt: Use Δβ = 10 log₁₀(I₂/I₁). If intensity increases by 1,000, what is sound-level change?
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: Using the same logarithmic rule, a 20 dB increase corresponds to what intensity ratio?
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A steady-frequency siren approaches a stationary observer through still air. Compared with emitted frequency, observed frequency is…
cpa.guide: Approach compresses arriving wavefront spacing, increasing received frequency.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

cpa.prompt: A source emits the same tone as it passes an observer and then recedes. What change is expected between approach and recession?
options: Only loudness can change; frequency cannot.
Observed pitch increases because the source is farther away.
The emitted frequency must change for any observed shift.
Observed pitch drops as the Doppler shift changes from higher to lower.
cpa.guide: Relative motion changes received frequency even with constant emitted frequency.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Compare evidence and identify a physical relationship.
